+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Extract existing XMM/solar-wind inputs and optionally fetch small supplements.
+
+Writes only alongside this script.  Existing analysis products remain read-only.
+python extract_inputs.py --fetch  # remote retrieval is cached, about 3 MB total
+python extract_inputs.py          # rebuild tables using already archived inputs
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import csv
+import datetime as dt
+import hashlib
+import json
+import shutil
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+import requests
+from astropy.io import fits
+from astropy.time import Time, TimeDelta
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+REPO = HERE.parents[2]
+SOURCE = REPO / "analysis_repro"
+SOLAR = SOURCE / "analysis_06_solar_wind"
+RAW = HERE / "raw"
+AU_KM = 149597870.7
+IDS = {"comet": "C/2025 N1", "stereo_a": "-234", "solar_orbiter": "-144", "ace": "-92", "wind": "399"}
+DATASETS = {
+    "stereo_a": ("STA_COHO1HR_MERGED_MAG_PLASMA", ["radialDistance", "heliographicLatitude", "heliographicLongitude", "BR", "BT", "BN", "B", "plasmaSpeed", "plasmaDensity", "plasmaTemp"]),
+    "solar_orbiter": ("SOLO_COHO1HR_MERGED_MAG_PLASMA", ["radialDistance", "heliographicLatitude", "heliographicLongitude", "BR", "BT", "BN", "B", "ProtonSpeed", "protonDensity", "protonTemp"]),
+    "ace": ("AC_K1_SWE", ["Np", "Vp", "Tpr"]),
+    "wind": ("OMNI2_H0_MRG1HR", ["PLS1800", "N1800", "V1800", "T1800", "ABS_B1800", "BX_GSE1800", "BY_GSE1800", "BZ_GSE1800"]),
+}
+
+
+def save_json(path, obj):
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(obj, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
+
+
+def table(path, rows, fields=None):
+    rows = list(rows)
+    with path.open("w", newline="") as f:
+        w = csv.DictWriter(f, fields or list(rows[0]), delimiter="\t")
+        w.writeheader()
+        w.writerows(rows)
+
+
+def fetch(url, params, path):
+    if path.exists():
+        return
+    response = requests.get(url, params=params, timeout=40, headers={"User-Agent": "3I-ATLAS-MHD-reproducible-research"})
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    path.write_text(response.text)
+    save_json(path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".provenance.json"), {"url": response.url, "retrieved_utc": dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(), "bytes": len(response.content)})
+
+
+def solar_basis():
+    # IAU solar north pole in ICRF; Horizons ecliptic is fixed J2000 IAU76.
+    ra, dec = np.deg2rad([286.13, 63.87])
+    eps = np.deg2rad(84381.448 / 3600)
+    pole_icrf = np.array([np.cos(dec) * np.cos(ra), np.cos(dec) * np.sin(ra), np.sin(dec)])
+    rot = np.array([[1, 0, 0], [0, np.cos(eps), np.sin(eps)], [0, -np.sin(eps), np.cos(eps)]])
+    z = rot @ pole_icrf
+    x = np.cross([0, 0, 1], z)
+    x /= np.linalg.norm(x)
+    y = np.cross(z, x)
+    return np.array([x, y, z])
+
+
+def ephemeris(name, download):
+    target = RAW / f"horizons_{name}.json"
+    # An initial directly inspected comet query is retained as-is.
+    initial = HERE / "horizons_comet_raw.json"
+    if name == "comet" and initial.exists() and not target.exists():
+        shutil.copyfile(initial, target)
+    if download:
+        values = {"COMMAND": IDS[name], "EPHEM_TYPE": "VECTORS", "CENTER": "500@10", "START_TIME": "2025-11-08", "STOP_TIME": "2025-12-15", "STEP_SIZE": "1h", "REF_PLANE": "ECLIPTIC", "REF_SYSTEM": "ICRF", "VEC_CORR": "NONE", "VEC_TABLE": "2", "OUT_UNITS": "AU-D", "CSV_FORMAT": "YES", "TIME_TYPE": "UT"}
+        params = {k: "'" + v + "'" for k, v in values.items()}
+        params["format"] = "json"
+        fetch("https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/api/horizons.api", params, target)
+    if not target.exists():
+        return None
+    d = json.loads(target.read_text())
+    if "$$SOE" not in d.get("result", ""):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"No states in {target}: {str(d)[:400]}")
+    rawrows = list(csv.reader(d["result"].split("$$SOE")[1].split("$$EOE")[0].strip().splitlines()))
+    jd = np.array([float(r[0]) for r in rawrows])
+    xyzv = np.array([[float(x) for x in r[2:8]] for r in rawrows])
+    xyz = xyzv[:, :3]
+    radius = np.linalg.norm(xyz, axis=1)
+    sun_xyz = xyz @ solar_basis().T
+    lon = np.degrees(np.unwrap(np.arctan2(xyz[:, 1], xyz[:, 0])))
+    lat = np.degrees(np.arcsin(xyz[:, 2] / radius))
+    slon = np.degrees(np.unwrap(np.arctan2(sun_xyz[:, 1], sun_xyz[:, 0])))
+    slat = np.degrees(np.arcsin(sun_xyz[:, 2] / radius))
+    t = Time(jd, format="jd", scale="utc")
+    rows = []
+    for k in range(len(jd)):
+        r = {"utc": t[k].isot, "mjd_utc": f"{jd[k]-2400000.5:.12f}"}
+        r.update(zip(["x_au", "y_au", "z_au", "vx_au_day", "vy_au_day", "vz_au_day"], map(float, xyzv[k])))
+        r.update(radius_au=radius[k], ecliptic_longitude_deg=lon[k], ecliptic_latitude_deg=lat[k], solar_equatorial_longitude_deg=slon[k], solar_equatorial_latitude_deg=slat[k])
+        rows.append(r)
+    table(HERE / f"ephemeris_{name}.tsv", rows)
+    return rows
+
+
+def mhd_supplement(name, download):
+    dataset, fields = DATASETS[name]
+    path = RAW / f"hapi_mhd_{name}.csv"
+    if download:
+        fetch("https://cdaweb.gsfc.nasa.gov/hapi/data", {"id": dataset, "parameters": ",".join(fields), "time.min": "2025-11-08T00:00:00Z", "time.max": "2025-12-30T00:00:00Z", "format": "csv"}, path)
+    if not path.exists():
+        return {}
+    return {r[0]: dict(zip(fields, map(float, r[1:]))) for r in csv.reader(path.open())}
+
+
+def plasma(name, download):
+    source = SOLAR / "cache" / f"{name}.csv"
+    cache = RAW / f"original_{name}.csv"
+    if not cache.exists():
+        shutil.copyfile(source, cache)
+    extras = mhd_supplement(name, download)
+    rows, invalid = [], 0
+    for r in csv.reader(cache.open()):
+        vals = list(map(float, r[1:]))
+        if name in ["stereo_a", "solar_orbiter"]:
+            speed, density = vals
+        elif name == "ace":
+            density, speed = vals
+        else:
+            code, density, speed = vals
+        valid = 0.01 < density < 500 and 100 < speed < 1500
+        if name == "wind":
+            valid = valid and int(code) == 52
+        if not valid:
+            invalid += 1
+            continue
+        t = Time(r[0], format="isot", scale="utc")
+        row = {"utc": t.isot, "mjd_utc": t.mjd, "density_cm3": density, "speed_km_s": speed, "proton_flux_cm2_s": density * speed * 1e5, "temperature_K": "", "B_magnitude_nT": "", "BR_RTN_nT": "", "BT_RTN_nT": "", "BN_RTN_nT": "", "BX_GSE_nT": "", "BY_GSE_nT": "", "BZ_GSE_nT": "", "source_radius_au": "", "source_HGI_latitude_deg": "", "source_HGI_longitude_deg": ""}
+        extra = extras.get(r[0], {})
+        mapping = ({"temperature_K": "plasmaTemp" if name == "stereo_a" else "protonTemp", "B_magnitude_nT": "B", "BR_RTN_nT": "BR", "BT_RTN_nT": "BT", "BN_RTN_nT": "BN", "source_radius_au": "radialDistance", "source_HGI_latitude_deg": "heliographicLatitude", "source_HGI_longitude_deg": "heliographicLongitude"} if name in ["stereo_a", "solar_orbiter"] else {"temperature_K": "Tpr"} if name == "ace" else {"temperature_K": "T1800", "B_magnitude_nT": "ABS_B1800", "BX_GSE_nT": "BX_GSE1800", "BY_GSE_nT": "BY_GSE1800", "BZ_GSE_nT": "BZ_GSE1800"})
+        for out, key in mapping.items():
+            if key not in extra:
+                continue
+            val = extra[key]
+            # HAPI fill values are much larger than any realistic measured value.
+            if abs(val) > 1e8 or ("temperature" in out and (val < 1 or val > 1e8)) or ("_nT" in out and abs(val) > 500) or ("radius" in out and not 0 < val < 10) or ("latitude" in out and abs(val) > 90) or ("longitude" in out and not -360 <= val <= 360):
+                continue
+            row[out] = val
+        rows.append(row)
+    table(HERE / f"plasma_{name}.tsv", rows)
+    return {"dataset": DATASETS[name][0], "valid_records": len(rows), "invalid_original_records": invalid, "first_utc": rows[0]["utc"], "last_utc": rows[-1]["utc"], "temperature_records": sum(r["temperature_K"] != "" for r in rows), "magnetic_records": sum(r["B_magnitude_nT"] != "" for r in rows), "original_sha256": hashlib.sha256(cache.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "units": {"density": "cm^-3", "speed": "km s^-1", "temperature": "K", "magnetic_field": "nT", "flux": "cm^-2 s^-1"}, "quality": "preliminary browse; unscaled density" if name == "ace" else "retained original manuscript cache n and speed; new B,T supplemental only"}
+
+
+def extract_gtis():
+    manifest = SOURCE / "analysis_01_reduction/outputs/03_events/frames.tsv"
+    copied = RAW / "original_frames.tsv"
+    if not copied.exists():
+        shutil.copyfile(manifest, copied)
+    rows = list(csv.DictReader(copied.open(), delimiter="\t"))
+    spans, frames = [], []
+    for row in rows:
+        event = Path(row["event"])
+        if not event.exists():
+            continue
+        with fits.open(event, memmap=True) as hdul:
+            head = hdul["EVENTS"].header
+            ontime = float(head["ONTIME"])
+            candidates = []
+            for hdu in hdul:
+                if hdu.data is None or not getattr(hdu.data, "names", None) or not {"START", "STOP"} <= set(hdu.data.names):
+                    continue
+                a = np.column_stack((hdu.data["START"], hdu.data["STOP"])).astype(float)
+                candidates.append((abs(np.sum(a[:, 1] - a[:, 0]) - ontime), hdu.name, a))
+            error, gti_hdu, a = min(candidates, key=lambda x: x[0])
+            assert error < 0.01
+            reference = float(head.get("MJDREF", head.get("MJDREFI", 50814) + head.get("MJDREFF", 0)))
+            base = Time(reference, format="mjd", scale=head.get("TIMESYS", "TT").lower())
+            t = (base + TimeDelta(a, format="sec")).utc
+            for k, (start, stop) in enumerate(a):
+                spans.append({"frame": row["frame"], "detector": row["det"], "interval": k, "start_utc": t[k, 0].isot, "stop_utc": t[k, 1].isot, "start_mjd_utc": t[k, 0].mjd, "stop_mjd_utc": t[k, 1].mjd, "duration_s": stop-start, "gti_hdu": gti_hdu, "source_path": str(event.relative_to(REPO))})
+            frames.append({"frame": row["frame"], "detector": row["det"], "gti_seconds": ontime, "start_utc": t[0, 0].isot, "stop_utc": t[-1, 1].isot, "reference_mjd": reference, "timesys": head.get("TIMESYS"), "gti_intervals": len(a), "header_start_utc": (base + TimeDelta(float(head["TSTART"]), format="sec")).utc.isot, "header_stop_utc": (base + TimeDelta(float(head["TSTOP"]), format="sec")).utc.isot})
+    if spans:
+        table(HERE / "xmm_gtis.tsv", spans)
+        save_json(HERE / "xmm_frames.json", frames)
+    else:
+        spans = list(csv.DictReader((HERE / "xmm_gtis.tsv").open(), delimiter="\t"))
+    return spans
+
+
+def main():
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    p.add_argument("--fetch", action="store_true")
+    args = p.parse_args()
+    RAW.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    ephems = {name: ephemeris(name, args.fetch) for name in IDS}
+    summary = {name: plasma(name, args.fetch) for name in DATASETS}
+    spans = extract_gtis()
+    for name in ["mapped_flux.tsv", "lightcurve.tsv", "result.json"]:
+        shutil.copyfile(SOLAR / "outputs" / name, HERE / ("manuscript_" + name))
+    shutil.copyfile(SOURCE / "parameters.json", HERE / "manuscript_parameters.json")
+    basis = solar_basis()
+    save_json(HERE / "coordinate_system.json", {"ephemeris_frame": "Sun-centered ICRF ecliptic J2000, geometric vectors; Horizons VEC_CORR=NONE", "time": "UTC, explicitly requested TIME_TYPE=UT; JDUT column minus 2400000.5", "position_units": "au", "velocity_units": "au/day", "solar_pole_icrf_ra_dec_deg": [286.13, 63.87], "ecliptic_obliquity_arcsec": 84381.448, "ecliptic_to_solar_equatorial_matrix": basis.tolist(), "solar_longitude_zero": "ascending node of fixed J2000 ecliptic and solar equator; arbitrary fixed inertial zero, NOT Carrington or true-of-date HGI", "matrix_usage": "solar_vector = matrix @ ecliptic_vector", "pole_source": "https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/sunfact.html", "HGI_source": "https://omniweb.gsfc.nasa.gov/coho/helios/plan_des.html"})
+    windows = {"analysis06_hardcoded": ["2025-12-03T12:04:07", "2025-12-04T10:11:54"], "manuscript_all_pointings": ["2025-12-03T12:37:38", "2025-12-04T17:22:29"]}
+    window_info = {}
+    for name, (start, stop) in windows.items():
+        t = Time([start, stop], format="isot", scale="utc")
+        window_info[name] = {"start_utc": start, "stop_utc": stop, "start_mjd_utc": t[0].mjd, "stop_mjd_utc": t[1].mjd, "elapsed_seconds": float((t[1] - t[0]).sec)}
+    for det in ["pn", "mos1", "mos2"]:
+        use = [r for r in spans if r["detector"] == det]
+        window_info[det + "_accepted_gtis"] = {"first_utc": min(r["start_utc"] for r in use), "last_utc": max(r["stop_utc"] for r in use), "gti_seconds": sum(float(r["duration_s"]) for r in use), "intervals": len(use), "frames": len({r["frame"] for r in use})}
+    save_json(HERE / "inputs_summary.json", {"obsid": "0963720201", "windows": window_info, "plasma": summary, "ephemerides": {name: {"rows": len(e) if e else 0, "file": f"ephemeris_{name}.tsv"} for name, e in ephems.items()}, "warnings": ["The analysis06 hardcoded window is the union bound of retained frame TSTART/TSTOP values, not accepted PN GTIs.", "Manuscript all-pointing interval includes rejected, flare-contaminated and filter-wheel-closed pointings; GTIs must weight direct light-curve comparisons.", "No contemporaneous heavy-ion abundance measured at the comet; adopted fraction 3e-4 to 1e-3 is a noncontemporaneous prior.", "OMNI Wind samples are already time shifted near Earth; Earth ephemeris is intentional.", "New supplemental plasma fields were downloaded 2026-10-16 and may reflect archive revisions relative to the manuscript cache.", "COHO HGI longitude must not be directly combined with ecliptic J2000 or Carrington longitude."]})
+    print(json.dumps(window_info, indent=2))
+    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch"));
